You are building the Dashboard page for a Shopify app called QuizSnap (a product recommendation quiz app). Write the file at `/Users/yashbaldha/Desktop/Shopify App/QuizSnap/app/routes/app._index.tsx`.

This is a Shopify embedded app using React Router v7 and @shopify/polaris React components. The app layout (app.tsx) wraps everything in PolarisProvider.

The Dashboard is the first screen a merchant sees. It must include:

## 1. Page Header
- Title: "Dashboard" with subtitle "Welcome to QuizSnap"
- Primary action: "+ Create quiz" button (navigates to /app/quizzes/new)
- Secondary action: "View analytics" button (navigates to /app/analytics)

## 2. Statistics Cards Row (4 cards in a horizontal row)
Use Polaris `Layout`, `Card`, `Text`, `InlineStack`, `BlockStack`, `Icon` components.

| Card | Metric | Color | Example Value |
|------|--------|-------|---------------|
| Attributed Revenue | Total revenue from quiz completers | green | $12,450 |
| Quiz Completions | Number of completed quizzes | blue | 1,247 |
| Conversion Rate | % of completers who purchased | purple | 18.3% |
| Emails Captured | Emails collected via quiz | amber/yellow | 892 |

Each card should show:
- A colored top border (use inline style `borderTop: '3px solid var(--p-color-xxx)'`)
- The metric name as a subdued label
- The main number in large bold text
- A trend indicator like "↑ 23% vs last month" in green or red

## 3. Setup Checklist Banner
Only shown when setup is incomplete. Uses Polaris `Banner`, `ProgressBar`, `List`.
- Title: "Complete your setup"
- Progress bar showing completion (e.g., 1 of 3 = 33%)
- Steps: 1) Create your first quiz ✓, 2) Map products to answers, 3) Publish your quiz
- CTA button: "Finish setup →"

## 4. Quiz List Table
Uses Polaris `IndexTable` with columns:
- Quiz (name + emoji thumbnail + sub-label)
- Status (Badge: Live=green/success, Draft=yellow/attention, Archived=grey)
- Questions count
- Completions count
- Conv. rate %
- Revenue $
- Updated date
- Actions (Edit button, Preview button)

Include mock data for 3 sample quizzes.

## Technical Requirements:
- Use loader to authenticate: `import { authenticate } from "../shopify.server";`
- Export loader, action, and default component
- Use `import { boundary } from "@shopify/shopify-app-react-router/server";` for headers
- Use `useNavigate` from react-router for navigation
- Import Polaris components from `@shopify/polaris`
- Use useCallback for event handlers
- Make the page fully functional with mock data
- Do NOT use any s-* web components, use only Polaris React components (Page, Layout, Card, etc.)

The file has been written at `/Users/yashbaldha/Desktop/Shopify App/QuizSnap/app/routes/app._index.tsx`.

Here is a summary of what was built:

**Page Header** -- Uses Polaris `Page` component with title "Dashboard", subtitle "Welcome to QuizSnap", a primary "+ Create quiz" action navigating to `/app/quizzes/new`, and a secondary "View analytics" action navigating to `/app/analytics`.

**Statistics Cards Row** -- Four `StatCard` components in a horizontal `InlineStack` (flex, no wrap), each with a colored top border, subdued label, large bold metric value, and a trend indicator with success/critical tone. Colors: green (revenue), blue (completions), purple (conversion rate), amber (emails captured).

**Setup Checklist Banner** -- A Polaris `Banner` with `ProgressBar` showing 1/3 completion (33%), numbered `List` of setup steps with checkmark on completed ones, and a "Finish setup" CTA. Automatically hidden when all steps are complete.

**Quiz List Table** -- A Polaris `IndexTable` with 8 columns displaying 3 mock quizzes. Each row shows an emoji + name + subtitle, a `Badge` with appropriate tone (success/attention/undefined for Live/Draft/Archived), question count, completions, conversion rate, revenue, updated date, and Edit/Preview action buttons.

**Technical details**: Uses `useCallback` for all handlers, `useNavigate` from react-router, `useIndexResourceState` for table selection, proper loader/action exports with authentication, and boundary headers export.
